rank_context: Calibrated via contrastive analysis of Diamond vs. Grandmaster Ana VODs on owreplays.tv. Key empirical finding: Diamond Anas do not simply throw too few offensive nades—in fact, losing Diamond Anas ('Flanking Ana' MFTXPE) often throw 80% of nades offensively during early poke when no teammate can follow up, leaving Biotic Grenade on cooldown during the actual brawl/dive. Meanwhile, GM5 Anas win fights by holding Sleep Dart strictly for committed flankers (Reaper/Tracer) and using high-impact dual-purpose nades during active tank/DPS engagements.

rules.category: Biotic Grenade Timing & Brawl Conversion (Unconverted Poke Nades vs. Forced Self-Heals)
rules.timeline_condition: Flag when: (A) Player throws an `offensive_anti` nade during early poke in a fight that is subsequently LOST (`unconverted_poke_nade`), OR (B) Player is forced to spend Biotic Grenade on isolated `self_heal` after taking avoidable poke damage (`self_heal_ratio > 0.30`).
rules.diagnostic_template: At [{timestamp}] ({alive_ratio} in Fight #{fight_id}, outcome: {fight_outcome}), you used Biotic Grenade on '{actual_target}' ({nade_usage}). Across this match, {unconverted_or_self_summary}.
rules.actionable_fix: Do not chuck long-range purple nades during early 5v5 poke before your Tank (Winston/Mauga/D.Va) has closed distance—enemy Kiriko/Baptiste will simply cleanse or wait it out, leaving you without E for the real brawl. Hold Biotic Grenade until your Tank commits onto a target or a flanker commits onto you.

rules.category: Sleep Dart Anti-Dive Discipline (Empirically 100% Fight-Loss Correlation When Violated)
rules.timeline_condition: Enemy composition contains dive/flank threat AND (player dies with `sleep_on_cd_when_dove == true` OR fires `is_poke_lottery_sleep == true` in a lost fight).
rules.violation_threshold: sleep_on_cd_when_dove == true OR (is_poke_lottery_sleep == true AND fight_outcome == 'LOST')
rules.actionable_fix: Across our GM5 vs. Diamond dataset (0AJTQ5 & D86HQF), every fight where Ana died with Sleep Dart on cooldown resulted in a 100% fight loss, whereas holding Sleep Dart for the flanking Reaper/Tracer inside close quarters won 100% of fights. Never fire long-range poke Sleep Darts down main corridors when enemy flankers are alive.

rules.category: Nano Boost Fight Economy (Unconverted Disadvantage Ult vs. Win-Con Turnaround)
rules.timeline_condition: Player activates Ultimate (Nano Boost) when `ally_alive - enemy_alive <= -1` AND `fight_outcome == 'LOST'`, OR loses a fight while holding >= 90% Ultimate charge without using Nano Boost.
rules.actionable_fix: Only invest Nano Boost at a numbers disadvantage if it directly enables a teamwipe win-condition combo (e.g. Nano + Dragonblade / Cage Fight before enemy defensive cooldowns). Conversely, if you have 100% Nano Boost in a 5v5/4v4 fight and your Tank/DPS is taking lethal pressure, deploy Nano proactively before they die.
